entries.title: Choose how often a batched project starts a batch
entries.body: A project on batched pull requests can now wait between batches, so more approved changes go up together and their checks run less often. Choose When a batch starts in Settings, Projects, such as at most every 3 hours, or ask your first mate. Changes approved meanwhile wait in line, and their merge says when the next batch starts. A held batch's fix still goes up at once. Everyone starts with As soon as a change is approved, which works as before.
